tools.name: jc_model_sdm_search
tools.title: Search Smart Data Models
tools.description: Models of the Smart Data Models catalogue whose name, description or attributes match q; import one with jc_model_sdm_import

q.description: A model, subject or attribute name, e.g. parking

subject.description: e.g. dataModel.Parking: search its attribute names too

models.description: Matching catalogue models, each with id (the import's model), name and description

more.description: More models matched than listed: narrow q

stale.description: The index is the older cached one

tools.name: jc_model_sdm_import
tools.title: Import A Smart Data Model
tools.description: Compiles one Smart Data Models catalogue model into LinkML and its artifacts. Writes nothing; proposing it as a DataModel is a separate change

model.description: subject/model as search lists it, e.g. dataModel.Parking/OnStreetParking

tools.name: jc_model_generate
tools.title: Generate Model Artifacts
tools.description: Compiles LinkML source into its artifacts (JSON Schema, JSON-LD context, SHACL and the rest) through the model tools service, or answers the messages of a source that does not compile. Writes nothing

outputSchema.description: The artifacts (jsonSchema, context, shacl, docs, example and the rest), or errors when the source does not compile

grants.description: Verbs on kinds and the bindings they come from

endpoints.description: Each Endpoint the subject reaches with its Policies and grant document

outputSchema.description: The reading, as the space's page shows it

tools.name: jc_organization_read

cursor.description: agentActivity: nextCursor of the previous page
